messages:
Lena: Quick sync
We need an SI onboarding run focused on: marketplace listing QA, lab rotations for private + hosted flows, and a short cert that covers KMS + network policies. Goal: first customer-ready demo in 10 days.
Tomas: +1. Suggest we split tracks: cloud-marketplace track and edge-hardware track. Different mentors for each.
Neha: for marketplace QA, we should give SIs a stub listing they must publish to a private catalog and run a validation check. I'll draft the validation script.
Ravi: for private deployments, include a KMS key naming convention and a sample terraform snippet. Shout if you want a template.
Becca: marketing/legal note: any co-branded collateral needs partner approval and a signed MOU. timeline usually 7-10 biz days. flagging for schedule.
Lena: thinking runbook:
  - Day 0: kickoff call + access checklist (console, sandbox creds, GH access)
  - Day 1-3: lab rotations (marketplace publish, deployment + smoke test, hardware perf check)
  - Day 4: practical cert + feedback review
  - Day 5: GTM/comm plan + announce window prep
Neha: for the deployment + smoke test lab, grader will check endpoints are reachable and latency < 200ms p95 for sample load. we can auto-grade via GH Actions.
Tomas: hardware perf check should include quantization pass and a simple run of the provided benchmark tool. propose a tiny command:
```
./bench.sh --model quantized-v1 --requests 50 --seq 256 --out report.json
python tools/validate_hw.py report.json --max-p95 180
```
Ravi: I'll add the terraform snippet to the repo. KMS example:
```
resource "aws_kms_key" "redwood_inference" {
  description = "SI onboarding key - <partner>-proj"
  tags = { project = "si-onboard" }
}
```
Becca: also add a checkbox in the onboarding doc: "Confirm partner marketing contact and logo use policy". don't push any logos to public pages until legal clears. :no_entry_sign: 
Lena: mentors/office hours: who can cover marketplace walkthroughs next week?
Neha: I can do Mon & Thu 2-4pm PT (marketplace + GH actions).
Tomas: I'll cover Wed 9-11am PT (hardware + infra).
Ravi: Fri 10-12 PT for private deployment + KMS/TLS questions.
partner-bot: Created event "SI Onboarding: Lab Rotations + Cert" on calendar for 1766190720. Invites sent.
Lena: metrics to track for success: time-to-first-demo, % pass on first cert attempt, partner satisfaction NPS. we'll instrument a short survey after cert.
Neha: we should capture common failure modes in a shared doc so mentors can triage fast. I'll create a Notion page and invite mentors.
Tomas: ops note: ensure sandbox has GPU quota and region parity with partner infra. add step to request quotas in the checklist.
Lena: good call. I'll update checklist and publish the playbook link here.
Becca: once we have a successful run, coordinate a soft-launch email with partner ops + a short case study template. legal + brand approvals required.
Ravi: one more: add a required smoke test that validates token usage reporting (billing signal) so partners see cost numbers during demo.
Neha: added. automated report will include token count and estimate cost.
Lena: perfect. next actions: Neha drafts grader + Notion doc, Tomas builds bench script, Ravi adds terraform & billing smoke test, Becca drafts partner comms checklist. reconvene after the kickoff event. :white_check_mark:
